title: vault.create
description: Create a further vault beside the primary: the service writes the new file and lists it in the primary (the manager app only). Endpoint: admin; direction: a2s; phase A. Unknown members are ignored by the reader (protocol.md section 8).

keys.description: The vault's keys: its password, key file and repository key; [C] a shared vault (with recipients) has no password.

recipients.description: [C] A shared vault's recipients file (an age file), written beside the new vault (section 6.4).

githubToken.description: The token of a github: vault outside the primary's repository, kept in its entry (section 6.4).

keysDue.description: When the vault's key file and repository key are due for rotation: its entry's Expires (section 6.4).
